units.source_text: 她把此诗写在寺中取来的诵经卷数记录单上。

en.t: She wrote this poem on the record sheet for the number of sutra recitations that had been brought from the temple.

units.source_text: 那使者说：“今晚不能回京了。”

en.t: The messenger said, "I cannot return to the capital tonight."

units.source_text: 便把记录单依旧系在那枝条上。

en.t: So he tied the record sheet back onto that branch as before.

units.source_text: 乳母说道：“我心跳得厉害呢！

en.t: Her nurse said, "My heart is pounding terribly!
The lady also said that she had had a bad dream.

units.source_text: 要吩咐守夜人小心在意！”

en.t: We must tell the night watchmen to be careful and alert!"

units.source_text: 浮舟躺着听她说，心中痛苦无限。

en.t: Ukifune lay there listening to her, her heart filled with boundless anguish.

units.source_text: 乳母又说：“一点东西也不吃，实在不好。

en.t: The nurse went on, "It is really not good for you to eat nothing at all.
She talked this way and that, caring for her in every possible way.

units.source_text: 浮舟想道：“这乳母自以为清健，但已年老貌丑，我死之后，叫她何处去安身呢？”

en.t: Ukifune thought, "This nurse believes herself still healthy and strong, but she is already old and unsightly; after I die, where will she find a place to live?"

units.source_text: 她替这乳母担心，觉得此人很可怜。

en.t: She worried about the nurse and felt deeply sorry for her.

units.source_text: 她想把自己即将辞世之事隐约告诉她。

en.t: She wanted to hint to her that she was soon going to leave this world.

units.source_text: 然而语未出口，泪已先流，恐人见疑，终于未能说话。

en.t: But before the words could leave her mouth, tears came first; afraid that others would grow suspicious, she was unable to speak after all.

units.source_text: 右近躺在她近旁，对她说道：“忧愁的人，灵魂会飘荡出去。

en.t: Ukon lay down near her and said, "When a person is full of sorrow, the soul may wander away.

units.source_text: 小姐近来只管忧愁，所以夫人要做噩梦。

en.t: You have done nothing but grieve lately, my lady, and that is why your mother has bad dreams.

units.source_text: 小姐应该打定主意跟从哪一方面，然后听天由命吧。”

en.t: You should decide once and for all which side you will follow, and then leave the rest to fate."
When she had said this, she sighed again and again.

units.source_text: 浮舟只是用她常穿的便服的衣袖遮住脸面，默默地躺着。

en.t: Ukifune simply covered her face with the sleeve of the everyday robe she usually wore and lay there in silence.
